speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Three. I have three in my count. Nobody left a hull for the arches to keep.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The real arch is behind us. I am telling it when there is a board, and not before, unless Joan asks, and she will not.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Tell it at home if you must. I am walking. The book is shut, and it is staying shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut, and home. The knife is in the belt. I have the three of you, and that is the whole of what leaves this grass.
